description: Greeter built in two phases: greeting, then admin reload on top (with a wrong reload message the Fixer repairs). With --max-fix 0 phase 2 fails and the run rolls back to phase 1.

replies.content: {"phases":[{"title":"Greeting","goal":"/greet and /greet <player> with a configurable message"},{"title":"Admin reload","goal":"/greeter reload for admins, with usage and no-permission messages"}]}

FILE: src/test/scenarios/greet-live.yml
```yaml
id: greet-live
covers: [AC2, AC3]
players: [alice, bob]
steps:
  - as: alice
    command: /greet bob
  - as: bob
    expect_chat: "Hello, bob!"
  - as: alice
    expect_chat: "Greeted bob."
```

FILE: src/test/scenarios/admin-reload-live.yml
```yaml
id: admin-reload-live
covers: [AC5, AC6]
players: [alice, bob]
setup:
  - op: alice
steps:
  - as: alice
    command: /greeter reload
  - as: alice
    expect_chat: "Greeter config reloaded."
  - as: bob
    command: /greeter reload
  - as: bob
    expect_chat: "You don't have permission to do that."
```
